summary: The landed main revision remains green under the final focused profile. In a fresh temporary project, the nine-iteration benchmark reports setup 7.172 s, verifier p50 2.179 s and p95/p99 2.779 s, and state_inspect p50 5.277 ms with p95/p99 50.007 ms. A separate retained verifier profile measured 30.1 ms authorization/request preparation, 288.6 ms action publication, 40.0 ms provider plus result construction, and 1,036.5 ms terminal receipt-plus-result publication for a 1,396.3 ms run; the Store generation delta was two. These numbers keep the remaining bottleneck in durable Store publication rather than Forge semantic subprocesses.
